cases.diagnostic: The spoon loses the dark cartoon outline and gains metal shading, but bowl depth and liquid/metal occlusion remain synthetic.
The spatula reads more clearly as metal, but the stretched payload texture and source-hole repair remain implausible.
Wood shading is less flat and rear/front partition is exact, but the lifted noodle remains visibly segmented.
Metal shading improves, but twirled-food texture, tine occlusion, and dark contact artifacts remain non-photographic.

decision: Close the deterministic renderer as an appearance ablation. Do not add more handcrafted shading rules. Run the already-frozen standard VACE-direct baseline before testing this materialized proxy as a separate learned-appearance condition.
